description: This file defines the class 'BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator' which is a decorator for the 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity. It provides methods to associate an employee and a comment by their IDs, and to retrieve formatted 'liked at' date and time strings. The class utilizes traits for ORM entity management and date/time formatting, indicating its role in entity decoration within the application.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzLikeOnComment entity, providing methods to set relations with Employee and BuzzComment entities, and to retrieve formatted timestamps of when a 'like' occurred.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzLikeOnComment entity.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Returns the BuzzLikeOnComment entity associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the comment based on employee number.

methods.name: setCommentByCommentId
methods.description: Associates a BuzzComment entity with the like based on comment ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the comment was liked, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the comment was liked, formatted as a string.
